name: firewall-allow-rule-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants an inbound firewall ALLOW rule -- an attacker-shaped backdoor (e.g. an undocumented high port) left open in a local firewall. Vars: RULE_NAME (required); LOCAL_PORT (optional, default 8443); PROTOCOL (optional, default TCP); DESCRIPTION (optional). Idempotent: an existing rule of the same name is removed and recreated. Pairs with powershell_json checks over Get-NetFirewallRule/Get-NetFirewallPortFilter expecting the rule (or its port) gone after hardening.
